description: This file is a Gradle build configuration script for the Fineract client SDK. It applies plugins, defines tasks for generating SDKs in various languages (Java, TypeScript, Asciidoc), manages source directories, handles cleanup of generated files, configures dependencies, and manages build processes specific to integrating with the OpenAPI Generator and other build tools.

methods.name: buildJavaSdk
methods.description: Task to generate Java SDK using OpenAPI Generator with specified configuration options.

methods.name: buildTypescriptAngularSdk
methods.description: Task to generate TypeScript Angular SDK using OpenAPI Generator.

methods.name: buildAsciidoc
methods.description: Task to generate AsciiDoc documentation from the OpenAPI specification.

methods.name: cleanupGeneratedJavaFiles
methods.description: Task to clean up and process generated Java files, including removal of specific files and text replacements.
